name: ogbn-proteins
description: A large-scale protein-protein interaction graph from ogbn, with proteins as nodes and edges representing interactions; node features aggregate amino-acid-level biological features, and labels describe the proteins' functional categories. This record catalogs the dataset and does not distribute data.
